children: Chainflip confirmed the theft of BTC from its vaults. Chainflip did not disclose how much BTC was taken.

Users who rely on Chainflip to hold assets in its vaults depend on the protocol to keep those funds safe. That protection is one reason users trust Chainflip. The theft weakens confidence in how the protocol behind FLIP protects the funds it holds.
We have sent an on-chain message to the address holding the BTC taken from Chainflip on 21 November.
